# Custom vendor welcome image

Tool: built-in `image_gen.imagegen` (imagegen skill). Generated 2026-10-07. Copied unchanged into `assets/vendor-welcome.png`.

Final prompt:

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: custom welcome hero photograph for Karryam Vendor mobile app. Create a premium editorial portrait of a confident friendly Nigerian female small business owner inside a beautifully organized contemporary food and grocery shop in Lagos, holding a tablet naturally at waist height, wearing a dark navy apron over a cream shirt, tasteful teal accents in shelving and packaging, warm human smile, natural skin texture, premium cinematic daylight with subtle teal bounce light, authentic sophisticated African commerce. Vertical portrait 4:5 composition, subject centered with upper body clearly visible and space around edges, curated groceries and produce in softly blurred background. Brand palette Midnight Navy #0B1F44 and Aurora Teal #00C2A8. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements. A polished real photograph, not illustration or plastic 3D.

The original Karryam logo was reused intact separately; it was not regenerated. This image is illustrative and makes no claim about an actual merchant.
